label: #3615469: Maintenance form login link, pinned core
description: Compare pristine core with MR !16609 on the maintenance settings form. The login link gains page; the full sentence and destinations remain unchanged. Desktop evidence does not reproduce the reported iOS VoiceOver behavior.
status: DRAFT: MR source reviewed; local Drupal runtime validation pending

steps.text: A Standard site is installed. The recipe makes no further site changes.
Reset viewer conditions to defaults. Read the checkbox help text and inspect its login link.
steps.lookFor: Before links user login; After links user login page. The sentence stays identical.

steps.text: Turn click mirroring off. Tab through the checkbox and its two description links in each frame. Do not save or enable maintenance mode.
steps.lookFor: Focus remains visible. The login link target is unchanged. A links list includes the complete phrase After.

expected: The login link includes the complete phrase user login page, with the same sentence and destination.
actual: Before links only user login; After links user login page. Runtime and iOS speech validation are pending.

checks.label: The login link includes page
checks.probe: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('input[name=maintenance_mode]'); return (b?.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).some(id => [...(document.getElementById(id)?.querySelectorAll('a') || [])].some(a => a.textContent.trim() === 'user login page')); })()

observe.label: The description login link is named user login page
Checkbox and description links have visible keyboard focus
